name: sopworld
description: Consistency matrices for SOP Lang circuits: self-consistent micro-worlds with deduction, abduction, induction and logical completion. Zero dependencies.

scripts.test: node tools/build.mjs && node --test && SOPWORLD_BUNDLE=1 node --test && SOPWORLD_COW_CHECK=1 node --test test/*.test.mjs compat/psys2/*.test.mjs
scripts.examples: node examples/deduction.mjs && node examples/abduction.mjs && node examples/induction.mjs && node examples/chat.mjs && node examples/twin.mjs && node examples/workflow.mjs && node examples/compose.mjs && node examples/solvers.mjs && node examples/time.mjs && node examples/aggregates.mjs && node examples/reader.mjs && node examples/space.mjs && node examples/delegation.mjs
